title: serde_json::to_value(...).unwrap_or(Value::Null) silently drops serialization errors
description: mailbox.rs, email.rs, identity.rs, submission.rs, vacation.rs — serde_json::to_value(&set_err).unwrap_or(Value::Null) is used ~15 times. If SetError fails to serialize (should be impossible but the type system doesn't prove it), the per-item error silently becomes null in the response, which the client cannot distinguish from a successful null. The correct form is serde_json::to_value(&set_err).map_err(|e| JmapError::server_fail(e.to_string()))? — or use a helper that asserts these are all infallible and panics with a clear message instead of silently corrupting the response.
notes: serde_json::to_value is infallible for SetError/SetErrorType (simple serde-derived types). Fixing would require major handler refactor for zero behavioral improvement. Acceptable as-is.
